claims.evidence: The photos only show the game title and PS4 label; the “111” is not visible/confirmable.
Photos show only the outside of the case; no seal/inside packaging or repair indicators are shown.

claims.claim: “Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.”
claims.evidence: No pads/accessories or UK receipt are shown in either photo.

risks.risk: Wrong item or wrong edition/region (e.g., not the exact PS4 disc/edition the buyer expects). Photos show the front cover only.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the disc (label side) and the back cover showing region/edition details.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used PS4 physical game with unknown edition/condition (worst case: disc may be missing/defective).

risks.risk: Disc not included, scratched, or not playable (seller claims “all ports working” is irrelevant to a game; no disc condition shown).
risks.proof: Photo of the disc out of the case plus a short video clip of the game being installed/launching on a PS4.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed to work (worst case: treat as not working).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/receipt (seller claims original pads and UK receipt, but nothing is shown).
risks.proof: Photo(s) showing the claimed “pads”/inserts and the UK receipt in hand.
risks.if_unproven: Priced without extras (worst case: only the case/cover).

risks.risk: Case damage or poor condition not visible in these angles (cracks, broken hinges, torn inserts).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the case edges, spine, hinge area, and inside insert.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as cosmetically used with possible case wear.

proof_requests: Photo of the disc (label side) and the inside insert/back cover.
Short video of the game being launched/working on a PS4 (or proof of disc readability).
Photos showing the claimed “pads”/inserts and the UK receipt.
response.reason: The photos confirm the PS4 game title on the case, but key parts that determine value and whether it works (disc presence/condition and any extras/receipt) are not shown, so a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
